name: Proses Sensor + Threshold

sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sensor(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,suhu REAL,kelembaban REAL,ts TEXT,received TEXT);
name: Buat Tabel
Cek API Key + Router

sql: SELECT suhu,kelembaban,ts AS timestamp,received FROM sensor ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50;
name: Ambil 50 Data
